# The Vedas

Public-domain English translation reader for the four Veda Samhitas: Rigveda, Samaveda, Yajurveda, and Atharvaveda.

Canonical URL:

- https://chiragmirani.github.io/vedas/

Primary resources:

- Reader: https://chiragmirani.github.io/vedas/
- About and source attribution: https://chiragmirani.github.io/vedas/about.html
- Machine-readable passage data: https://chiragmirani.github.io/vedas/data.json
- Sitemap: https://chiragmirani.github.io/vedas/sitemap.xml

Content summary:

- 4 Vedas
- 52 books
- 2,251 passages
- Verse-by-verse public-domain English translation
- Plain meaning generated from the English translation for study support

Source translations:

- Rigveda: Ralph T.H. Griffith, 1896, via SanskritWeb public-domain PDF.
- Samaveda: Ralph T.H. Griffith, 1895, via Sacred Texts.
- Yajurveda: Arthur Berriedale Keith, Taittiriya Samhita of the Black Yajurveda, 1914, via Sacred Texts.
- Atharvaveda: Ralph T.H. Griffith, 1895-1896, via Sacred Texts.

Use notes:

- The Vedas are traditionally received as shruti.
- Translator/source labels identify the English editions used for this digital reader, not authorship of the Vedas.
- Plain meanings are modernized readings from the public-domain English translation, not traditional Sanskrit commentary.
